mapper.update: update biz_member set points = points + #{delta}, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update biz_member set growth_value = growth_value + #{delta}, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update biz_member set consume_count = consume_count + 1, consume_amount = consume_amount + #{amount}, last_consume_time = now(), update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}

update biz_member_balance set principal_balance = principal_balance - #{principalPart}, gift_balance = gift_balance - #{giftPart}, total_balance = total_balance - #{amount}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and total_balance >= #{amount}

update biz_member_balance set principal_balance = principal_balance + #{principalPart}, gift_balance = gift_balance + #{giftPart}, total_balance = total_balance + #{principalPart} + #{giftPart}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}

update biz_member m join biz_member_balance b on b.member_id = m.member_id set m.balance_principal = b.principal_balance, m.balance_gift = b.gift_balance, m.update_time = now() where m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_point_log (member_id, change_type, points_change, points_after, batch_id, ref_no, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{memberId}, #{changeType}, #{pointsChange}, #{pointsAfter}, 0, #{refNo}, '', now(), #{remark})

insert into biz_member_growth_log (member_id, change_type, growth_change, growth_after, ref_no, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{memberId}, 1, #{growthChange}, #{growthAfter}, #{refNo}, '', now(), '消费累加')
